title: Approve a Related-Party Transaction
description: Board approval for a contract or arrangement with a related party, with the interested-director disclosure this specifically requires.

questions.label: How many clear days' notice was given for this meeting?
How many directors are present at this meeting?
Nature of the transaction
questions.placeholder: e.g. sale of goods, leave and licence of premises

questions.label: Name of the interested director (if any)
questions.tooltip: Leave blank if no director has a personal interest in this transaction.

questions.label: Has the interested director's disclosure of interest been recorded?

template.agendaTitle: To approve a related-party transaction with {{related_party_name}}
template.proposal: The Company proposes to enter into a transaction of {{transaction_nature}} with {{related_party_name}} ({{relationship_nature}}), valued at Rs. {{transaction_value}}, on the terms set out below. The Board members discussed and approved the following resolution.
template.body:
"RESOLVED THAT pursuant to the provisions of Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Meetings of Board and its Powers) Rules, 2014, and subject to such other approvals as may be required, the consent of the Board be and is hereby accorded for the Company to enter into the following transaction with {{related_party_name}}, a related party by virtue of {{relationship_nature}}: {{transaction_nature}}, valued at Rs. {{transaction_value}}, on the following terms: {{transaction_terms}}.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any one Director of the Company be and is hereby authorised to negotiate, finalise and execute all documents necessary to give effect to this transaction and to file necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies, {{roc_jurisdiction}}.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any one Director or the Company Secretary be and is hereby authorised to make necessary entries in the Register of Contracts maintained under Section 189 of the Companies Act, 2013."
template.minutesGist: Meeting held on {{meeting_date}} at {{meeting_place}}. The Board considered a proposed related-party transaction with {{related_party_name}} ({{relationship_nature}}) for {{transaction_nature}} valued at Rs. {{transaction_value}}, and approved the resolution above.{{#if interested_director_name}} {{interested_director_name}}, an interested director,{{#if interest_disclosed}} disclosed their interest under Section 184 and{{/if}} did not participate in the discussion or vote on this item.{{/if}}

interest_disclosed.meaning: Confirms the interested director declared their interest under Section 184 before this item was discussed.
interest_disclosed.tip: An interested director must not vote on the resolution and, other than for certain exempt companies, is excluded from quorum for this item.
